response.justification: Despite strong general software development experience, this candidate is unsuitable for this embedded security role. He lacks the required Japanese language proficiency (a hard blocker) and has no background in embedded systems security, which is the core of this position. His career is entirely focused on web and backend development. While he has some C and Linux experience, it is limited and dated, and the role requires deep expertise in embedded firmware security and Linux kernel analysis that he has not demonstrated.
strengths: Extensive software development experience spanning 15+ years across multiple programming languages and domains
Fluent English proficiency with proven ability to work effectively in international and distributed teams
Strong track record of rapidly learning and mastering new technologies and technical domains
concerns: No evidence of Japanese language proficiency, which is a required qualification for this role
Career background is entirely in web and backend systems development, not embedded systems or security
Limited and outdated C programming experience (last mentioned in 2014-2015); current work focuses on TypeScript, Node.js, and D
